message: ドン亀理事長奮戦記
Several days have passed since Kirafes came to a close amid high praise.
I make my way down to the pier where the people of Ryuusei Town go to relax.
Thanks to the cooperation of everyone in town, starting with the shopping district, Kirafes was a huge success.
Even though the people spending time in Tsukinoo Park look just the same as always, it fills me with deep emotion.
By the time the Holy Night Festival ends, I wonder if the way I see things will have changed again?
I feel a bit awkward blatantly people-watching. Idly, I shift my gaze out toward the sea.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... was there always a buoy over in that spot?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Synn-chan\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Helena-san. Are you fishing?」

name: Helena
message: 「Today... all the fish around here have run off, you know?」
Why would she state that with such certainty?

name: Helena
message: 「Still, noticing that buoy is pretty sharp of you. Make sure you treasure that keen eye for spotting small changes in everyday life, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're giving me too much credit. More importantly, what on earth is that--」

name: Riesling
message: 「From Riesling Tohyama to Helena. Preparations are complete. Over.」

name: Helena
message: 「All right, let's do this, Tamiko-chan! Emergency surfacing!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-wha?」
The buoy vanished between the waves. No, did it submerge?
Suddenly, a wide stretch of the ocean's surface begins foaming white. Then, the white turns pink, and the very instant it swells ever so slightly--

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaah!?」

name: Helena
message: 「...Too slow.」
A giant Tontoro emerges from beneath the sea and moors alongside the jetty. Compared to the piggy bank Lolotte carries around, its size is on a completely different scale.
Seawater is being discharged from its nostrils, suggesting that the main ballast tanks are located somewhere around there.
Likewise, the tail on its rear is spinning like a propeller, so it seems to be based on naval engineering, at least in theory.

name: Paqy
message: 「What a complete waste of technology.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Helena, excuse me from the conning tower.」
The giant Tontoro's yellow ribbon opens, and Riesling-san appears from inside. The ribbon seems to function as a hatch.

name: Riesling
message: 「No malfunctions found in the rigging, starting with the superconducting electromagnetic propulsion system and Tontoro hydrophones.」

name: Riesling
message: 「The eyeball torpedo tubes, rapid-reload system, foaming agents, and other armaments are all operating nominally as well.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have registered the codes for Helena, myself, and Melilot into the King's Valve.」

name: Synn
message: 「A T-Tontoro-shaped submarine?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Calling it a mere submarine is akin to calling a dog 'dog.'」

name: Riesling
message: 「The official designation of this vessel is the Ojousubmarine. Please make no mistake.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, Tamiko-chan, you're getting way ahead of yourself. We're still in the middle of performance tests, aren't we? We're nowhere near the christening ceremony yet!」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Helena, could it be that...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Emergency surfacing in eleven seconds flat! Too slow!! If this were real combat, the crew would be dead.」

name: Helena
message: 「Cut it down to five seconds.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a tall order.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the familiarization and operation of Milady's secret weapon to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte's?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's submerging...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, oh, Tamiko-chan♪」

name: Helena
message: 「That ship doesn't just belong to Lolotte-chan--it belongs to you, Ria, and everyone in the Crusaders.」

name: Helena
message: 「Though a situation where you and the others have to board it isn't exactly desirable. If Re-Crea is smoothly averted, we won't even need the Ojousubmarine.」

name: Synn
message: 「If that happens, I bet Lolotte will remodel it into a sightseeing sub and take it out for deep-sea exploration.」

name: Helena
message: 「Not a bad idea. When that happens, let's go on a deep-sea date together\s04」
I stayed at the pier for a while, watching the Ojousubmarine's test run. In the end, Riesling-san managed to get the emergency surfacing down to three seconds.
Out of sheer curiosity, I kind of want to see the inside of the ship.
Still, I need to keep the threat of Re-Crea to a minimum so this vessel never has to be handed over to the Crusaders!
